Liechtenstein being a small nation has always had a problem with creating its own energy. Liechtenstein has to import 92% of its energy needs to function. This then makes up for a large percentage of Liechtenstein's 2.2 billion per year import costs.

Liechtenstein however has made many gains in recent years with renewable energy. Liechtenstein is actually the highest Solar power per capita in the world since 2015. Liechtenstein wants to keep is number 1 spot and also decrease its need on foreign nations for power.

Therefore Liechtenstein has decided to make a 500 million USD $ contract with Rawlemon. A company who has a new style of solar energy systems that are not only 57% efficient (normal styles are roughly 27% efficient) but also look stylish that therefore will not have a negative effect on Liechtenstein's tourism market.
Iceland applauds Liechtenstein's funding of renewable energy. We are strong advocates for clean power.
